name: add_franchise_order_and_product_audit_trail
statements:
-- Immutable database-side audit trail for franchise orders and product master data.
-- This does not change the current business tables or export queries.

create table if not exists public.franchise_change_audits (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  entity_type text not null check (entity_type in (
    'order',
    'order_item',
    'order_adjustment',
    'product'
  )),
  entity_id uuid not null,
  order_id uuid,
  operation text not null check (operation in ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')),
  before_data jsonb,
  after_data jsonb,
  changed_by uuid,
  changed_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  transaction_id bigint not null default txid_current()
)

create index if not exists franchise_change_audits_entity_idx
  on public.franchise_change_audits(entity_type, entity_id, changed_at desc)

create index if not exists franchise_change_audits_order_idx
  on public.franchise_change_audits(order_id, changed_at desc)
  where order_id is not null

create index if not exists franchise_change_audits_changed_at_idx
  on public.franchise_change_audits(changed_at desc)
alter table public.franchise_change_audits enable row level security
drop policy if exists "franchise change audits read by role" on public.franchise_change_audits

create policy "franchise change audits read by role"
on public.franchise_change_audits
for select
to authenticated
using (
  (public.current_franchise_role())::text in (
    'franchise_admin',
    'franchise_hq',
    'franchise_coo',
    'franchise_cfo'
  )
  or (
    order_id is not null
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.franchise_orders orders
      where orders.id = franchise_change_audits.order_id
        and orders.franchise_store_id = public.current_franchise_store_id()
    )
  )
)
revoke all on table public.franchise_change_audits from public
revoke all on table public.franchise_change_audits from anon
revoke all on table public.franchise_change_audits from authenticated
grant select on table public.franchise_change_audits to authenticated

create or replace function public.capture_franchise_change_audit()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public, auth
as $$
declare
  audit_entity_type text;
  audit_entity_id uuid;
  audit_order_id uuid;
begin
  audit_entity_type := case tg_table_name
    when 'franchise_orders' then 'order'
    when 'franchise_order_items' then 'order_item'
    when 'franchise_order_adjustments' then 'order_adjustment'
    when 'franchise_order_products' then 'product'
    else null
  end;

  if audit_entity_type is null then
    raise exception 'Unsupported franchise audit table: %', tg_table_name;
  end if;

  audit_entity_id := case
    when tg_op = 'DELETE' then old.id
    else new.id
  end;

  audit_order_id := case
    when tg_table_name = 'franchise_orders' and tg_op = 'DELETE' then old.id
    when tg_table_name = 'franchise_orders' then new.id
    when tg_table_name in ('franchise_order_items', 'franchise_order_adjustments') and tg_op = 'DELETE' then old.order_id
    when tg_table_name in ('franchise_order_items', 'franchise_order_adjustments') then new.order_id
    else null
  end;

  insert into public.franchise_change_audits (
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    order_id,
    operation,
    before_data,
    after_data,
    changed_by,
    changed_at,
    transaction_id
  )
  values (
    audit_entity_type,
    audit_entity_id,
    audit_order_id,
    tg_op,
    case when tg_op in ('UPDATE', 'DELETE') then to_jsonb(old) else null end,
    case when tg_op in ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') then to_jsonb(new) else null end,
    auth.uid(),
    now(),
    txid_current()
  );

  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    return old;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$
revoke all on function public.capture_franchise_change_audit() from public
revoke all on function public.capture_franchise_change_audit() from anon
revoke all on function public.capture_franchise_change_audit() from authenticated
drop trigger if exists capture_franchise_order_audit_trigger on public.franchise_orders
drop trigger if exists capture_franchise_order_item_audit_trigger on public.franchise_order_items
drop trigger if exists capture_franchise_order_adjustment_audit_trigger on public.franchise_order_adjustments
drop trigger if exists capture_franchise_order_product_audit_trigger on public.franchise_order_products

create or replace function public.prevent_franchise_change_audit_mutation()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  raise exception 'Franchise audit records are immutable.';
end;
$$
revoke all on function public.prevent_franchise_change_audit_mutation() from public
revoke all on function public.prevent_franchise_change_audit_mutation() from anon
revoke all on function public.prevent_franchise_change_audit_mutation() from authenticated

drop trigger if exists prevent_franchise_change_audit_mutation_trigger
  on public.franchise_change_audits

comment on table public.franchise_change_audits is
  'Immutable before/after audit trail for franchise orders, line items, adjustments, and product master data.'
